office: Abbess of a convent in Suzdal

names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's life page, «Преподобная Евфросиния Суздальская», with the rank word left off.
Her baptismal name, as the calendar's day line gives it: «Прп. Евфросинии Суздальской, в миру Феодулии (1250)».

birth.note: days.pravoslavie.ru, Life/life1603.htm: «Преподобная Евфросиния, княжна Суздальская, родилась в 1212 году».

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru, Life/life1603.htm: «Преподобная преставилась к Богу 25 сентября 1250 года»; the day line prints «(1250)».

feast.note: The same page lists a second memorial, «18 сентября (Прославление)» — her glorification at Suzdal in 1698. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and she does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 25 сентября ст. ст. — «Прп. Евфросинии Суздальской, в миру Феодулии (1250).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 25 septembrie, which is the civil day her Julian 25 September falls on in that calendar, was not read (2026-10-04). doxologia.ro/8-octombrie was read for this civil day and does not name her.
Not checked: saint.gr/09/25, the Greek calendar's own 25 September, was not read (2026-10-04). saint.gr/10/08 was read for this civil day and does not name her.

Not read: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for 2026-10-08 prints only «Преп. Ефросинија», which is Euphrosyne of Alexandria on the same Julian day, and its entry list is known to drop entries (2026-10-04).

locations.historical_name: the Suzdal convent in honour of the Deposition of the Robe of the Mother of God
